note: Peak resident memory (MB) of the process of each kind of layer of F2a/F2b on BRA, the largest country, measured in the cold round of 2026-11-03 (interim/BRA/*/layers.json; COMMANDS 88/89; docs/_audit/memory_budget_88.md). The guard waits for peak_rss_mb + margin of free memory before a layer starts. F3 (land_eligibility) is not a layer process: it runs by stripes of rows since COMMAND 91 and peaks at 1,438 MB on BRA (see f3_phase).

phase_caps.note: Cap per phase of the pipeline (COMMAND 131, core/memory_cap.py): cap_mb = ceil(1.25 x the peak measured on BRA, the largest country) rounded up to a multiple of 64 MB; a phase may go up to 25% above it while the free memory covers the excess plus over_cap_reserve_mb (the excess is written to the manifest as peak_over_cap); the hard limit is cap_mb x 1.25. A phase with no entry here has `cap_mb` of the file (1,536 MB). peak_rss_mb is the larger of the manifest's `peak_rss_mb` and `cold_peak_rss_mb` of the phase in outputs/BRA/manifest.json on measured_on; the peaks of technical_potential and potential_maps are those of COMMAND 129 (BRA 1,579 and 1,676, IND 1,018 and 1,207, PRT 338 and 657). The phases of F6 to F8 and the support phases were never run on real data and have the default.
